thought.text: All 20 containers are healthy. Let me verify platform functionality through service endpoints.

reasoning_content:
All containers healthy. Now let me verify the actual platform functionality - access the admin panel and verify login. The guide says navigate to http://localhost:8082. We can't do browser-based login easily, but we can test the APIs. Let me check the front page and health endpoints of services.

Let me verify signing in via API using the admin.p12 certificate would be complex. Let me at least verify the admin-front page content and the ping endpoints.

Let me check that containers respond on ping endpoints.

action.command: cd /workspace && for c in admin-api:8102 cabinet-api:8101 id-api:8100 register:8103 external-reader:8104 filestorage:8105 persist-link:3346 sign-tool:3004 pdf-generator:7007; do svc=${c%%:*}; port=${c##*:}; out=$(docker compose exec -T $svc sh -c "node -e \"const http=require('http');http.get('http://localhost:$port/test/ping',r=>{console.log(r.statusCode);process.exit(0)}).on('error',e=>{console.log('ERR:'+e.code);process.exit(0)})\"" 2>/dev/null); echo "$svc ($port): $out"; done
